verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents 30 official, idiomatic SDKs (13 client-side, 13 server-side, 4 edge), with SDK reference docs such as the Cloudflare edge SDK and official OpenFeature providers. Community users confirm hands-on use of its mobile client SDK and streaming SDK clients. missing for 10: a documented enumeration of supported languages and reference docs for SDKs beyond Cloudflare in the pack (one community post notes an Elixir SDK was once unavailable).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: 30 idiomatic SDKs 13 client-side, 13 server-side, and 4 edge SDKs.
If you are using Cloudflare SDK version 2.3.0 or later, you can use the Cloudflare SDK by itself.
LaunchDarkly offers official OpenFeature providers for several of our SDKs
LaunchDarkly SDKs can pass any context attributes you want to LaunchDarkly, where you can then use those attributes in flag targeting.
LaunchDarkly has a mobile client SDK
